in_marathi.name: Sheen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sheen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sheen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chandra Shekhar' which means 'God of the Moon'. It is a beautiful and elegant name with deep spiritual significance. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess of the Moon, Chandra, is often depicted as having a radiant, shining face, which is symbolic of the name Sheen.
